result.content: 1. # maplibre-contour 2. 3. maplibre-contour is a plugin to render contour lines in [MapLibre GL JS](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) from `raster-dem` sources that powers the terrain mode for [onthegomap.com](https://onthegomap.com). 4. 5. ![Topographic map of Mount Washington](demo.png) 6. 7. [Live example](https://onthegomap.github.io/maplibre-contour) | [Code](./index.html) 8. 9. To use it, import the [maplibre-contour](https://www.npmjs.com/package/maplibre-contour) package with a script tag: 10. 11. ```html 12. 13. ``` 14. 15. Or as an ES6 module: `npm add maplibre-contour` 16. 17. ```js 18. import mlcontour from "maplibre-contour"; 19. ``` 20. 21. Then to use, first create a `DemSource` and register it with maplibre: 22. 23. ```js 24. var demSource = new mlcontour.DemSource({ 25. url: "https://url/of/dem/source/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", 26. encoding: "terrarium", // "mapbox" or "terrarium" default="terrarium" 27. maxzoom: 13, 28. worker: true, // offload isoline computation to a web worker to reduce jank 29. cacheSize: 100, // number of most-recent tiles to cache 30. timeoutMs: 10_000, // timeout on fetch requests 31. }); 32. demSource.setupMaplibre(maplibregl); 33. ``` 34. 35. Then configure a new contour source and add it to your map: 36. 37. ```js 38. map.addSource("contour-source", { 39. type: "vector", 40. tiles: [ 41. demSource.contourProtocolUrl({ 42. // convert meters to feet, default=1 for meters 43. multiplier: 3.28084, 44. thresholds: { 45. // zoom: [minor, major] 46. 11: [200, 1000], 47. 12: [100, 500], 48. 14: [50, 200], 49. 15: [20, 100], 50. }, 51. // optional, override vector tile parameters: 52. contourLayer: "contours", 53. elevationKey: "ele", 54. levelKey: "level", 55. extent: 4096, 56. buffer: 1, 57. }), 58. ], 59. maxzoom: 15, 60. }); 61. ``` 62. 63. Then add contour line and label layers: 64. 65. ```js 66. map.addLayer({ 67. id: "contour-lines", 68. type: "line", 69. source: "contour-source", 70. "source-layer": "contours", 71. paint: { 72. "line-color": "rgba(0,0,0, 50%)", 73. // level = highest index in thresholds array the elevation is a multiple of 74. "line-width": ["match", ["get", "level"], 1, 1, 0.5], 75. }, 76. }); 77. map.addLayer({ 78. id: "contour-labels", 79. type: "symbol", 80. source: "contour-source", 81. "source-layer": "contours", 82. filter: [">", ["get", "level"], 0], 83. layout: { 84. "symbol-placement": "line", 85. "text-size": 10, 86. "text-field": ["concat", ["number-format", ["get", "ele"], {}], "'"], 87. "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"], 88. }, 89. paint: { 90. "text-halo-color": "white", 91. "text-halo-width": 1, 92. }, 93. }); 94. ``` 95. 96. You can also share the cached tiles with other maplibre sources that need elevation data: 97. 98. ```js 99. map.addSource("dem", { 100. type: "raster-dem", 101. encoding: "terrarium", 102. tiles: [demSource.sharedDemProtocolUrl], 103. maxzoom: 13, 104. tileSize: 256, 105. }); 106. ``` 107. 108. # How it works 109. 110. 111. 112. [`DemSource.setupMaplibre`](./src/dem-source.ts) uses MapLibre's [`addProtocol`](https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js-docs/api/properties/#addprotocol) utility to register a callback to provide vector tile for the contours source. Each time maplibre requests a vector tile: 113. 114. - [`DemManager`](./src/dem-manager.ts) fetches (and caches) the raster-dem image tile and its neighbors so that contours are continuous across tile boundaries. 115. - When `DemSource` is configured with `worker: true`, it uses [`RemoteDemManager`](./src/remote-dem-manager.ts) to spawn [`worker.ts`](./src/worker.ts) in a web worker. The web worker runs [`LocalDemManager`](./src/dem-manager.ts) locally and uses the [`Actor`](./src/actor.ts) utility to send cancelable requests and responses between the main and worker thread. 116. - [`decode-image.ts`](./src/decode-image.ts) decodes the raster-dem image RGB values to meters above sea level for each pixel in the tile. 117. - [`HeightTile`](./src/height-tile.ts) stitches those raw DEM tiles into a "virtual tile" that contains the border of neighboring tiles, aligns elevation measurements to the tile grid, and smooths the elevation measurements. 118. - [`isoline.ts`](./src/isolines.ts) generates contour isolines from a `HeightTile` using a marching-squares implementation derived from [d3-contour](https://github.com/d3/d3-contour). 119. - [`vtpbf.ts`](./src/vtpbf.ts) encodes the contour isolines as mapbox vector tile bytes. 120. 121.
